input: The text camera profiles of the QNC root (catalogs/cameras, one JSON file per camera model); the XML texts of a card's records.
output: The profiles kept in the camera database of this computer (data/qnc-cameras.db, of which this block is the only writer), the files refused with why, and the camera of a card's records (its profile, or the record format's default).
specification: User 2026-10-23: a block reads the camera's records and compares them with text files in which the procedure for that camera is written; the initial data are text, the application reads them and writes them permanently into the database. A file with an error is not taken; the last valid record of its profile stays.
